parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kettle is made of ceramic and fits snugly on top of the base body to cover the opening.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents heat and steam from escaping and can be removed to fill or clean the kettle.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is a curved ceramic part attached to the side of the kettle for holding and pouring.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to safely lift and pour the kettle without touching the hot body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the kettle, made of ceramic with a spout for pouring.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the liquid and transfers heat evenly when placed on a heat source.
parts.Movement_description: It is stationary and serves as the main structural component of the kettle.
